name: @capgo/capacitor-native-navigation
description: Capacitor plugin for native navbar, tabbar, safe-area handling, and WebView snapshot transitions.
author: Martin Donadieu <martin@capgo.app>

scripts.verify: bun run verify:ios && bun run verify:android && bun run verify:web
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.lint: bun run eslint && bun run prettier -- --check && bun run swiftlint -- lint
scripts.fmt: bun run eslint -- --fix && bun run prettier -- --write && bun run swiftlint -- --fix --format
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run docgen && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
scripts.example:build: bun run build && cd example-app && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.example:sync: bun run example:build && cd example-app && bunx cap sync
scripts.example:ios: bun run example:build && cd example-app && ([ -d ios ] || bunx cap add ios) && bunx cap sync ios && bunx cap run ios
scripts.example:android: bun run example:build && cd example-app && ([ -d android ] || bunx cap add android) && bunx cap sync android && bunx cap run android
